What the document actually contains is FOUR PAGES of the unfilled v. 12.23 template — p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' — plus TWO CLERK REDACTION BARS on the cover and nothing else. That is redaction, not emptiness, and it is the only evidence on the document that a person handled it. NOTHING IS ATTRIBUTED FROM index.csv: it names candidate 'Alan Wessman', office 'County Commission Seat C' and period '7 Days before General', and the PAGE FACE states none of those — no name, no office, no seat, no report type, no date.
